payload.text: **Intent: rhadamanth is off limits; gyges runs it from Homebrew only** (hv, 23 Sep). Never relink, pull, bootstrap or brew-link Intent on rhadamanth; its manifest disables Molt's intent liberator (Molt-matts 857d49c). The one sanctioned write there is `intent issues add|edit` in ~/Devel/prj/Intent. gyges is the everyday-user test bed with no local dev tree; Intent-from-brew problems go to intent-vc, not into Molt workarounds. Changes on gyges or kovacs go through their sleeve agents (gyges-sysadm, kovacs-sysadm), reached through rhadamanth-sysadm or hv.
